contexts.text: When a man is intent on any thing...
Thought or intention, and therefore the end. Signified.
Thought to do is nothing else than intention; that is, end.
It is known from his thought alone what he intends to say.
The ends are as innumerable as are the intentions.
Who turns the best intentions of others... into wickedness.
They who have imbued the life with evil, are bent by... intending good... Their intention or end is then regarded...
Intention (in the sense of intentness). Signified. AC 3202. AC 4339.
The Angels attend only to... the ends, or to the intentions... and to the thoughts thence.
The Most Ancients... had no fear that others should know their ends and intentions...
It is believed to be a matter of civil prudence to speak, act, and show by the expression of the face, differently from what one thinks and intends.
Others cannot bend the mind thither.
An evil opinion and intention... Signified, Explained.
As spheres originate from loves... they originate from the intentions and ends for the sake of which the man so wills and acts...
Everyone is judged according to the end or intention.
The quality (of interior obsessions) may be evident if one attends to the thoughts and affections, especially to the interior intentions which they are afraid to manifest...
All evil which springs from... the intention or end of evil... is contrary to Divine order...
They who are in vastations, that is, they who have been in principles of falsity, and in a life of evil from falsity, and yet in good as to the intentions...
Such, therefore, as is the intention or end in discourse and in works, such is the life...
To descend = a mind to, or intention.
That which saves them is the intention of doing good...
That they intend nothing but evil. Signified, Explained.
For the evil which is thought against anyone, is intended; and as the alienated things cannot intend good, it is said that they intend nothing but evil.

(For) the man who has been alienated from good and truth intends nothing but evil... and that which he intends reigns with him, and therefore it is in all his thoughts... for the intention or end is the veriest life of the man. (Continued. See End.)
To think for good = to intend; but, as it is said of God, it = to turn into good; for what God intends He does.
They intend nothing but evil, but the Divine turns it into good. Treated of, Explained.
For they intend nothing but good towards the neighbour... It is otherwise with those who are in evil... for they intend nothing but evil to the neighbour; if good, it is for the sake of self.
The interior good, and also the interior evil, which are signified by man, are those which are of the intention or end; for the intention or end is the inmost of the man.
The life of man is his love; and what he loves, he wills and intends; and what he wills and intends, he does. This is of the man...
The angelic Spirits regulate the punishment according to the intention in the deeds, and according to the will in the thoughts.
That the falsities from evil which are intended to be brought upon others redound... upon themselves. Signified.
As it is from a law of order that evil relapses upon those who intend the evil...

It often happens in the other life... that the evil which they intend for others relapses upon themselves... The good cannot take away the evil of the penalty, because they are then kept in the intention of good...
Jehovah brought back upon them the waters of the sea = that the falsities of evil which they intended for the good relapsed upon them, from the presence of the Lord with those who are in good.
That the falsities of evil which they intend for others relapse upon themselves by a law of order. References.
If the end or intention is to do good for the sake of reputation...

All things which a man has thought, intended, and done from infancy, have added themselves to his life, and have made it; and have also formed such a connection among themselves, that one thing cannot be removed unless they are all removed...
In the Inmost Heaven (they perceive the Word) as is wont to be the case with an intention or end.
Hence the end propter quem, or the intention, is the man himself.
From thought alone with some intention...
The Angel... remove, as far as possible, evil intentions.
The external acts are such as are the intentions and thoughts...
With everyone there are... exterior and interior thoughts and intentions.

The thoughts... tend according to the intentions, or in the direction in which the man intends; for the thought... is like the external sight, in that it is turned... to where it is bent and intended...
It is the man's love which makes the intention...

The intention of a man, from which his internal sight or thought is determined, is his will; for what a man wills he intends; and what he intends he thinks. If, therefore, he intends Heaven, his thought is determined thither...

The thoughts... which proceed from the intention or will, are (there) represented by ways. Ways are also presented... exactly according to the thoughts of the intention; and everyone walks according to his thoughts which proceed from intention.
Deceit enters more inwardly into the thoughts and intentions, and infects them with poison.
The man who examines himself... must examine his thoughts, and the intentions of his will.
Hence from the deeds of a man others judge of the thought of his will, which is called his intention.
There are many things of wisdom; as... thought, intention to a thing... These are indeed of both (love and wisdom), but they are denominated from the more prevalent and near.
The mind... aims the eye to see.
There are some... who strain the mind to explore...

The spirit is examined no otherwise than by the man attending to his thoughts, especially to his intentions; for the intentions are the thoughts from the will. Evils are there in their origin and in their root; that is, in their concupiscences and in their delights... That to think from intention is to will and to do, is evident from... .
Man knows his own thoughts and thence his intentions, because he sees them in himself.
By thinking and willing, and also by intending, but still not by doing...
The love of the will inflows into the understanding... thence it comes into the thoughts, and also into the intentions...
But... when man is allowed to think the evils of his life's love even to intention, they are cured by spiritual means...
In proportion, then, as he resists the evils, he does not admit them into his intentions, and at last not into his thoughts.
The reason man is permitted to think evils even to the intention of them, is...
Spiritual light discloses the thoughts... spiritual heat the affections... and spiritual light and heat together the intentions and endeavours.
The works of the mind are intentions and endeavours...
As the intention which is of the will is primarily regarded by the Lord...
The soul inclines in both will and thought; that is, in intention...

The end goes forth from the will, and produces for itself a cause in the understanding, and presents to itself an intention; and an intention is as an act before determination. Hence it is, that by a wise man, and also by the Lord, an intention is accepted as an act.
With these, a conjugial life is the purpose, intention, or end...
Because a man is such a man as he is in his purpose, intention, or end...
They who separate these two in perception and intention...
All are contemplated from the purpose, intention, or end... CL 527:end. TCR 523:2.

That which flows forth from... the will... is principally called the purpose; but that which flows forth from... the understanding and its thought is called the intention; and guilt is predicated principally of the will...
That the Divine love continually intends conjunction. Signified.
These are murders in intention, but not in act... That hatred is murder. Signified. The reason is that everything which is of intention is also of the will, and thus, in itself, is of the deed.
The reason is that concupiscence is as a deed when it is in the will... for the intention is in the will, and the intention of concupiscence is deed.
This infinite diversity between the goodwill of one and of another, originates from the end, the intention, and the consequent purpose...
In the seed... are concealed, as it were the end, intention, and purpose of producing fruits...
As a temple of God, man has salvation and eternal life as his end, intention, and purpose. In these there is a correspondence with the will, in which these three are.
The quality of any love is predicated from the end which it regards and intends.
As the will inflows into all things of intention... and the understanding into all things of thought...
A robber, who directs his mind... after booty.
That true repentance is to explore intentions of one's will. General article.

The root is torn up... when the man explores the intentions of his will, and removes the evils by repentance. A man explores the intentions of his will when he explores his thoughts; for in these the intentions manifest themselves...
If he directs his mind to this...
When anyone is... intending evil, he should say to himself, I think this, and I intend this; but as it is a sin I will not do it. By this the temptation injected by Hell is broken...
As the end is the purpose, and this intends, purpose is also of the will, and through intention enters the understanding...
The whole sphere opposes the things which the Angels intend.
That they are as it were intentions...
The evil... can better penetrate the thoughts and intentions of others than the good.
That when evil Spirits intend evil to the good, the communication is at once closed.
Without any intention of hurting him...
These thoughts are as it were thinking intentions...
It is in (the interior sphere of the World of Spirits) where the intentions of men, or their ends, reign...
In this sphere, which may be called a sphere of intentions...

Those Spirits... do indeed inflow into the thoughts of man, but do not perceive them, but only their intentions; and therefore when such intentions are absent from man, these Spirits cannot understand...
An art innate in them through almost continual intentions in the life of the body...
In the interior sphere are intentions or ends ceasing in the world and in self: such natural intentions or ends exist more at this day... SE 2777.
When anyone intends evil actually, the like is reflected from me upon him. Explained.
That... Spirits see all the thoughts of man, and... his intentions.
Interior Spirits have a speech still more interior; namely, one of intentions.
With such force... was the intention (of the infants) directed, that it could not be resisted...
a. The intention for which they wanted to be so subtle reigned in everything else...
The innumerable applications of the lungs to the several muscles... according to all the intention and will of the thought...
From his answer, the Angels could clearly perceive the intention he had had...
The Angels perceive at once from a man's answer what kind of an intention he has had...

Nor do the Angels perceive anything except the intention, end, or will. They do not know their words. Therefore, when the intention, end, or will... is good, the words may fall in whatever way they do fall...

They entered... into each and all things... of the intentions, and extinguished, suffocated, and perverted them, so that nothing could be thought, because they had taken possession of the intentions, even of intentions of which I was completely ignorant, and which were within the sphere of my perception.
If anything to be done comes into intention, thus into will and into act...

These loves... turn all their thoughts and intentions to self and the world... and in proportion as man's thoughts and intentions are turned to his hereditary proprium... they are turned away from Heaven... (But) when a man loves God above all things... the Lord turns the interiors of... his thought and intention to Himself...

The life which is in the works is the intention which is of the will and of the derivative thought... Hence the wise do not look at the works, but to this life in the works, namely, at the intention. This is especially done by the Angels who are with the man: hey do not see his works, but only the intentions of his mind; and thence infer the quality of the man's state.
Then the Lord from the Sun directs His virtue... to protect the Angels...
7. 2. The love produces from itself affections, of which are the intentions...

2. The end intends, or wills to do what it loves... The Lord... from His Divine love perpetually intends, or wills, to do uses... Man... being in the love of uses... in this love intends, or wills, to do uses.
The tables and the heaps of books upon them were... representations of the intentions of the mind and of the consequent deeds, according to which (they) will be judged.
